sourceTitle: Listening to teens on online safety
originalTitle: Listening to teens on online safety
author: Will Gardner

blocks.text: Childnet has worked towards making the internet a great and safe place for over 30 years; however, it feels like concerns around online safety have never been higher. Whilst these conversations around online safety are happening, it is crucial that children and young people’s perspectives are taken into account.
blocks.zh: Childnet 三十多年来一直致力于让互联网成为一个美好而安全的地方；然而，感觉围绕网络安全的担忧从未像现在这样高。在这些关于网络安全的对话进行之际，充分考虑儿童和年轻人的观点至关重要。
blocks.en: Childnet has worked towards making the internet a great and safe place for over 30 years; however, it feels like concerns around online safety have never been higher. Whilst these conversations around online safety are happening, it is crucial that children and young people’s perspectives are taken into account.

blocks.text: At Childnet, youth voice is at the heart of everything we do, and we pride ourselves on not just listening to young people, but having their opinions shape everything we do. Young people tell us they believe that change is needed online and that significantly more needs to be done to make the online world a safe and positive space.
blocks.zh: 在 Childnet，青少年的声音是我们一切工作的核心，我们引以为豪的不仅是倾听年轻人，更是让他们的意见塑造我们所做的一切。年轻人告诉我们，他们认为网络需要改变，并且需要付出显著更多的努力，让网络世界成为一个安全、积极的空间。
blocks.en: At Childnet, youth voice is at the heart of everything we do, and we pride ourselves on not just listening to young people, but having their opinions shape everything we do. Young people tell us they believe that change is needed online and that significantly more needs to be done to make the online world a safe and positive space.

blocks.text: Why we need to listen to young people
blocks.zh: 为什么我们需要倾听年轻人
blocks.en: Why we need to listen to young people

blocks.text: Google’s The Future Report, which spoke to more than 6,000 UK teenagers, found that 67% use AI tools creatively daily. This mass adoption of this technology is very much in line with our own research released in February for Safer Internet Day 2026, which found that nearly all young people aged 8 to 17 (97%) use AI tools, with 58% saying that AI makes their lives better.
blocks.zh: 谷歌的《The Future Report》对 6,000 多名英国青少年进行了调查，发现 67% 的人每天创造性地使用 AI 工具。这种技术的大规模普及与我们在 2026 年“更安全互联网日”发布的自家研究非常一致，该研究发现几乎所有 8 至 17 岁的年轻人（97%）都使用 AI 工具，其中 58% 表示 AI 让他们的生活变得更好。
blocks.en: Google’s The Future Report, which spoke to more than 6,000 UK teenagers, found that 67% use AI tools creatively daily. This mass adoption of this technology is very much in line with our own research released in February for Safer Internet Day 2026, which found that nearly all young people aged 8 to 17 (97%) use AI tools, with 58% saying that AI makes their lives better.

blocks.text: Our research found that young people liked to use AI for a variety of reasons, with 71% of young people saying that AI saves them a lot of time, while a growing number are using it for help and support, with 64% agreeing that AI is the best way to get advice quickly.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究发现，年轻人喜欢使用 AI 的原因多种多样，71% 的年轻人表示 AI 帮他们节省了大量时间，而越来越多的人使用 AI 来获得帮助和支持，64% 的人认同 AI 是快速获得建议的最佳方式。
blocks.en: Our research found that young people liked to use AI for a variety of reasons, with 71% of young people saying that AI saves them a lot of time, while a growing number are using it for help and support, with 64% agreeing that AI is the best way to get advice quickly.

blocks.text: Both pieces of work show that young people are aware of the risks or challenges which come with spending time online, and of the impact of an overreliance on AI and other emerging technologies.
blocks.zh: 这两项工作都表明，年轻人意识到上网带来的风险或挑战，也意识到过度依赖 AI 和其他新兴技术的影响。
blocks.en: Both pieces of work show that young people are aware of the risks or challenges which come with spending time online, and of the impact of an overreliance on AI and other emerging technologies.

blocks.text: We found that 41% of teens feel like people their age are relying heavily on AI for emotional support or help with emotional issues, while almost one in seven (14%) say they use AI tools to discuss things they don’t feel they can talk to anyone else about. This could also be seen across The Future report, where almost a fifth (18%) of teens surveyed (and 20% of 16-18s) reported chatting to AI "as a friend".
blocks.zh: 我们发现，41% 的青少年认为同龄人正严重依赖 AI 来获得情感支持或帮助解决情绪问题，而近七分之一（14%）表示，他们会使用 AI 工具讨论那些觉得无法与其他人谈论的事情。这一点在《The Future Report》中也有体现，近五分之一（18%）的受访青少年（16 至 18 岁青少年中为 20%）表示会把 AI “当作朋友”聊天。
blocks.en: We found that 41% of teens feel like people their age are relying heavily on AI for emotional support or help with emotional issues, while almost one in seven (14%) say they use AI tools to discuss things they don’t feel they can talk to anyone else about. This could also be seen across The Future report, where almost a fifth (18%) of teens surveyed (and 20% of 16-18s) reported chatting to AI "as a friend".

blocks.text: We also can’t ignore the real fears that young people have shared about AI, with 60% of young people saying they are concerned about someone using AI to make inappropriate pictures of them, as well as concerns around the impact on creativity and schoolwork, and even for emotional support or friendship.
blocks.zh: 我们也不能忽视年轻人对 AI 表达的真实担忧，60% 的年轻人表示担心有人利用 AI 制作他们的不当图片，同时他们也担心 AI 对创造力和学业的影响，甚至对 AI 被用于情感支持或友谊感到担忧。
blocks.en: We also can’t ignore the real fears that young people have shared about AI, with 60% of young people saying they are concerned about someone using AI to make inappropriate pictures of them, as well as concerns around the impact on creativity and schoolwork, and even for emotional support or friendship.

blocks.text: Through our work in schools, our youth advisory boards, and in our focus groups, we see time and time again that young people are not only willing to have conversations about their life online, but that they are eager to have their voices heard about the issues that matter most to them.
blocks.zh: 通过我们在学校的工作、青年咨询委员会和焦点小组，我们一次又一次地看到，年轻人不仅愿意就他们的网络生活进行对话，而且渴望就对他们最重要的问题发出自己的声音。
blocks.en: Through our work in schools, our youth advisory boards, and in our focus groups, we see time and time again that young people are not only willing to have conversations about their life online, but that they are eager to have their voices heard about the issues that matter most to them.

blocks.text: The role of parents and carers
blocks.en: The role of parents and carers

blocks.text: Parents and carers play a key role in supporting their children online. Our research found that 74% of young people would talk to a parent or carer if they were worried about AI; however parents and carers need more support and resources too. Less than 1 in 5 parents have set rules or guidelines for how their child can use AI at home and only 13% know where to go for advice or support if they are worried about their child’s use of AI.
blocks.zh: 父母和照护者在支持孩子上网方面发挥着关键作用。我们的研究发现，74%的年轻人如果对AI感到担忧，会与父母或照护者交谈；然而，父母和照护者也需要更多的支持和资源。不到五分之一的父母为孩子在家如何使用AI制定了规则或指导方针，只有13%的父母知道如果担心孩子使用AI，可以去哪里寻求建议或支持。
blocks.en: Parents and carers play a key role in supporting their children online. Our research found that 74% of young people would talk to a parent or carer if they were worried about AI; however parents and carers need more support and resources too. Less than 1 in 5 parents have set rules or guidelines for how their child can use AI at home and only 13% know where to go for advice or support if they are worried about their child’s use of AI.

blocks.text: The Future report also showed young people who were willing to have these conversations with their parents and carers. Approximately three in ten teens indicated that allowing their parents to supervise their online activities (30%) was a helpful measure.
blocks.zh: 《未来》报告还显示，年轻人愿意与父母和照护者进行这些对话。约三成青少年表示，允许父母监督他们的在线活动（30%）是一项有帮助的措施。
blocks.en: The Future report also showed young people who were willing to have these conversations with their parents and carers. Approximately three in ten teens indicated that allowing their parents to supervise their online activities (30%) was a helpful measure.

blocks.text: At Childnet, we have a range of free resources to help parents, carers, and educators have conversations with young people about their life online, including our Family Agreement, conversation starters, and youth voice in online safety toolkit. We also have specific resources designed to talk about AI, both in the classroom and at home.
blocks.zh: 在Childnet，我们提供一系列免费资源，帮助父母、照护者和教育工作者与年轻人就他们的网络生活进行对话，包括我们的 Family Agreement、对话开场白和在线安全中的青少年声音工具包。我们还有专门设计用于在课堂和家中讨论AI的资源。
blocks.en: At Childnet, we have a range of free resources to help parents, carers, and educators have conversations with young people about their life online, including our Family Agreement, conversation starters, and youth voice in online safety toolkit. We also have specific resources designed to talk about AI, both in the classroom and at home.

blocks.text: There is a feeling of a state of flux, of often rapid change, in both technology and the rules around access to technology – in this context, education and conversations which take on board young people’s experience will be more important than ever.
blocks.zh: 无论是技术还是有关技术获取的规则，都给人一种处于不断变化、常常快速变化的状态——在这种背景下，纳入年轻人经验的教育和对话将比以往任何时候都更加重要。
blocks.en: There is a feeling of a state of flux, of often rapid change, in both technology and the rules around access to technology – in this context, education and conversations which take on board young people’s experience will be more important than ever.
